concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-graphql-guides-request-batching]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree website guide to a `v0` GraphQL batch transport for sequential operations and scalar exports between them, preserving required media type, whole-batch authentication, non-short-circuit errors, five-operation snapshot limit and separation from SDK or commit-qualified schema support
warnings: Keep the work-in-progress and 2026-09-16 snapshot qualification; do not claim current availability or eligibility.
Do not infer SDK support or attribute this website transport extension to the separately retained commit-qualified GraphQL schema source.
Preserve that errors do not stop later operations and that unresolved exports are omitted before dependent operations run.
